decisions.rationale: Stone chapel, 8.6 x 22 m, buttressed nave with lancet windows, west tower with a spire to 22.4 m, slate roof; 656 triangles, 57,704 bytes before meshopt. Walls stay inside the oriented-box collider below 3 m and eaves overhang at most 0.78 m above it (check-kit: OK); baked AO at 48 samples.
limitations: Lancets are dark recesses; no tracery or stained glass.
The spire is a plain four-sided slate pyramid without lucarnes or a weathervane.
Surfaces are tiled 2 m layers shared by the whole kit; there is no unique wear, grime gradient or decals per building.

decisions.rationale: In Star Monastery (rebuilt around its v2 landmark) at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): reads at true scale beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss; shadows ground it on the relief; the 1.6-3.2 m architecture cutaway keeps the hero visible behind it, and a camera inside its bounds (plus 2 m) hides it instead of showing the hollow inside.
limitations: Not enterable: interiors are not modelled.
Lighting is the overcast day grade only; windows never light up.
